rules.check: exact fields, fixed union tags, reject duplicate JSON keys and unknown versions
resolve a real original JSON/JSONL/text/chunk position; reject invented arrays and absent-field pointers
verify original stored and decoded receipt under explicit encoding; do not guess gzip filenames
source/root/context or namespace+kind+original local_id plus original record; bare ID is insufficient
actual relations must retain original Run/process/visit/slot scope and provider membership
derive scope/obligation IDs from immutable original anchors and stable rule keys, never status/time/order
missing source/call/dispatch/native/OS domain creates an explicit collection obligation anchored in capture membership
declared, partial and enumerated inventories remain distinct from actual observation coverage
every enumerated original member must map to all applicable obligation IDs; retain independent domain membership
unknown count, missing members, unfinished chunks and budgets remain collection-level OPEN with exact cursor
exactly structural attribution, dependency connection, internal expansion and runtime evidence; no omitted/empty requirement-set success
requirement expansion scans every original input/result/state/completion/resource slot, preserving duplicate Uses
names, same type, same local ID, adjacent time and retained ancestors cannot establish actual data/state/native call edges
SOURCE_BODY and other preselected required_expansion cannot be lowered after UNSUPPORTED or opaque effects
interface acceptance requires ordered inputs/results, state posts, alias/escape, control/failure, resources and ready/lifetime
preserve STATIC_SOURCE/ACTUAL_OBSERVATION/VERSIONED_CONTRACT/CONDITIONAL; do not promote static to observed
original argv/cwd/code-env/config/input/run/process/window/provider layers must have correct sources; analysis machine values cannot repair old capture
selection/version/loss/window/process/thread/parser prerequisites must support claimed coverage; CLOSED/zero drops alone is insufficient
NOT_APPLICABLE requires exact exclusion evidence and a fixed policy rule; no observation is not exclusion
retain additions/removals/modifications with reasons, especially mandatory, relation sets, expansion, snapshot and scope changes
reuse accepted semantic evidence only for exact immutable artifacts, producer/dependency hashes, schema/capability, scope and requirement-set
ordinary query reuses accepted evidence and local immutable snapshot caches; no full raw rescan or new owned live session per query
query reports REUSED_ACCEPTED, exact original gate/range, unreplayed sources and remaining conditions; caller PASS booleans are not receipts
new facts/ranges/policy obligations or mismatching dependencies invalidate only affected reuse and trigger necessary producer-gate checks
ledger contains requirements and reviews only; canonical facts remain in original Program/Execution/Value/Evidence graphs
a published ledger or all-false summary without per-member obligations and collection debt is not automatic coverage
unknown=0 with missing domain/member/count/cursor/obligation or unreviewed condition remains OPEN
full dispatch pipeline retains every original group/phase/failure/unknown operator; never select schema-known or small-prefix subset

verification_cost_tiers.independent_audit: explicit bounded replay mode, separately costed and scoped
verification_cost_tiers.ledger_publication: membership/count/locator/axis/receipt checks; reuse exact accepted semantic gates and recheck only changed requirements
verification_cost_tiers.ordinary_query: local row/endpoint/receipt lookup plus immutable cache; no global raw replay or new live-owned session; disclose reuse and remaining conditions
verification_cost_tiers.producer_gate: full semantic audit for exact immutable inputs/producer/scope once; whole dispatch producer joins raw once

zero_unknown_counterexample: 0 unknown plus any missing domain/member/obligation/identity/cursor/unreviewed condition must remain OPEN
